exclusion_reason: The unified representation, the one WGSL emitter, and the static single-emitter audit in the planning gate are implemented; every frontend lowers into the one representation. The benchmark remains red because rendering on a live adapter needs the browser runtime and the declared corpus evidence.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the fixture corpus lowers through the unified representation and the static audit proves exactly one emitter.
expected_failing_assertion: No shader representation or emitter exists to audit.
active_gate_evidence: The static audit in the planning gate counts exactly one WGSL emitter across the tree, and the shader suite lowers the same program deterministically through it.
procedure: Lower each declared frontend fixture through the unified representation.
Emit WGSL from the single emitter and compile on the live adapter.
Run the static emitter audit over the source tree.
pass_criterion: Every fixture lowers through the one representation.
The audit finds exactly one emitter.
